source_grounded: scripts/+ppe/run_cstar.m: C* acts via winfun -> Pbar bins -> ECMS lambda (delta_lambda) -> battery/genset power split only (law6_lambda_eff)
scripts/+model/build_commitment_chart_e.m + build_pms_v2_e.m: DG commitment/start/stop commands are PMS v2 chart + safety interlock functions of genset-side load; independent of delta_lambda
scripts/+ppe/c2_bridge.m / winfun_plan.m: forecast window only selects Pbar; no direct actuator command
cstar_actuator_authority.verdict: C* has authority ONLY over the lambda/power-split channel; DG commitment, start commands, synchronization timing and generator ramp are outside C* actuator authority

H_four_arm_similarity_and_authority.mechanism_vs_differentiation: BEFORE_FORECAST_DIFFERENTIATION: the dominant failing evidence is the t<60 s startup transient, common to all arms by warm-up parity; forecast-source information cannot influence it

I_wall_verdict.verdict: NO SUPPLY-SIDE WALL: at every large demand-vs-achieved deficit, instantaneous generator headroom + battery SOP exceeded the deficit; the deficit is load-side propulsion inertia, not a generation/reachability wall

explicitly_excluded.CONTROLLER_AUTHORITY_LIMITATION_as_prima: true but vacuous: the failing mechanism is common-mode and BEFORE t=300 differentiation (48/48 per arm, t_first<=30 s; C0=C1=C2 identical 48/48; P0=C0 identical 48/48), so no controller with any information could influence it
explicitly_excluded.MISSION_PLANT_ENVELOPE_MISMATCH: no steady or instantaneous capacity wall found (supply headroom present at every deficit)
explicitly_excluded.NUMERICAL_BOUNDARY_ARTIFACT: the transients are physical (600 kW x seconds of real propeller acceleration), not solver noise

primary_evidence: authoritative P_unserved_kWh == 0.0 on ALL 192 arm-voyages (checker + 1 Hz trajectory); the undervoltage-derate service-failure channel never fires

load_shortfall fails ONLY via the service_gap component (P_prop_demand - P_prop_actual), median 0.378 kWh/voyage: normal propulsion/hull acceleration lag at startup (max 600 kW, 45% of energy in t<50 s) plus <=14 kW speed-profile tracking lag in cruise (44,384 sub-20-kW episodes)
the gap energies are BITWISE IDENTICAL across P0/C0/C1/C2 (median 0.37829742233260666 on all four arms): common-mode physical transient, not controller behavior
no supply-side wall: at all 96 large-deficit episodes the instantaneous generator headroom + battery SOP exceeded the deficit (I verdict)
secondary_evidence: genset_limits_state_aware fails ONLY via PMIN (pmax/ramp/non-on/native high-rate all zero, incl. 0.01 s audit)
DG1 PMIN 48/48 voyages, DG2 46/48; 124 episodes, 1362 s total, ~7 s per arm-voyage (0.7% of T_eval), max excursion 125 kW (ON at P=0)
context: post-ON power ramp-up window of the genset first-order model (tau=5 s) and low-load dispatch windows — a plant/PMS transition phase, not steady dispatch
K_classification.verdict: MIXED: contract semantics dominant + PMS transition window secondary

components: FEASIBILITY_CONTRACT_AMENDMENT_CANDIDATE (dominant): service_gap is the FC-2 dual-consistency DIAGNOSTIC but the frozen checker included it in the hard predicate at 1e-6 kWh tolerance, making normal ship acceleration a hard violation; amendment would restore the approved design intent (authoritative = P_unserved, gap = diagnostic with divergence fail-closed only when P_unserved==0 while gap indicates curtailment-class loss)

FEASIBILITY_CONTRACT_AMENDMENT_CANDIDATE (secondary): state-aware PMIN predicate could exempt the genset model's own post-ON power ramp-up window (tau=5 s) and shutdown windows, mirroring the existing ramp ON<->ON exemption
NOT powertrain/mission redesign and NOT controller-authority extension: no capacity wall exists and the mechanism precedes forecast differentiation
L_recommendation.note: diagnostic recommendation only; no redesign implemented
